name: Luco and Wong (1986) coherency function
equation: gamma(omega, D) = exp[-(gamma_c omega D / Vs)^2], omega = 2 pi f in rad/s, D = horizontal separation, Vs = representative shear-wave velocity (INCOH <alpha>), gamma_c = dimensionless coherence parameter per motion component (INCOH <gammax>, <gammay>, <gammaz>)
parameters: No fixed coefficients: gamma_c and Vs are user input. Typical gamma_c 0.10-0.30 (ACS SASSI manual Section 6.5.4, Error 58 for gamma_c < 0.1); Luco and Wong suggest gamma_c / Vs between 2e-4 and 3e-4 s/m.

source.primary: J. E. Luco and H. L. Wong (1986). Response of a Rigid Foundation to a Spatially Random Ground Motion. Earthquake Engineering and Structural Dynamics, 14, 891-908 (ACS SASSI manual reference 55).
source.form_confirmed_from: EPRI/NRC public meeting presentation 'Session 6: CLASSI Approach to Incoherency' (J. Johnson / S. Short, 2007, NRC ADAMS ML072620217), slide 6 'Coherency Ground Motion Function (vertically incident waves)': exp[-(gamma omega |r1 - r2| / Vs)^2], gamma dimensionless, omega in rad/s; guidance Vs * 2e-4 s/m <= gamma <= Vs * 3e-4 s/m.
